description: Rothco's Paracord Knife with Fire Starter is a must-have tool for any outdoor enthusiast or survivalist. Measuring 8 inches in total length, this versatile knife features a 3.5-inch black blade made from 420 stainless steel, ensuring durability and sharpness. The handle is wrapped with sturdy paracord, providing a comfortable and secure grip, while also offering an additional survival tool. The survival knife comes with a durable polyester sheath, complete with a hook & loop handle strap to keep it securely in place. Attached to the sheath is a 3 1/8-inch magnesium fire starter and a convenient storage pouch, making it easy to ignite a fire in any condition. Whether you're preparing for a camping trip or assembling your bug out bag, Rothco’s Paracord Knife with Fire Starter is an essential tool that combines practicality and reliability in a compact design.
